summary: An open, community-run live-streaming network I own end to end. Launched in 2026 as a single streaming site and grown, in the same year, into seven connected apps sharing one login, with me as the only engineer on it.
bullets: Designed and built an entire network of seven apps that work together under one account: live streaming, sign-in and a virtual-currency wallet, media storage, a 169-tool toolbox, a browser game and a community hub. About 363,000 lines of code and 900+ web endpoints — all built, deployed and kept running by me alone.

Built the live-streaming engine from the ground up: anyone can broadcast from a browser or an app, and it automatically re-broadcasts to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and more at the same time, saves the recording and auto-generates short clips. It also produces live captions and translates them into about 21 languages in real time, and uses AI to spot and label the best moments in every stream.

Ran it like a real product: I built a deploy pipeline that updates the live site with zero downtime viewers ever notice, cut the homepage's load time roughly in half and eliminated the jarring layout jumps it used to have, and — when it came time to move everything to new infrastructure — moved every user, every account balance and every active player over with zero downtime and zero data loss.
